title: add-repr-to-agent
request: Hey, can we make printing an agent show its name? I'd like __repr__ to include the agent's name for debugging.

+import builtins
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+import pytest
+from smolagents.agents import MultiStepAgent, ActionStep
+
+class SimpleAgent(MultiStepAgent):
+    def initialize_system_prompt(self) -> str:
+        return ""
+    def step(self, memory_step: ActionStep):
+        # No operation steps
+        return iter(())
+
+def test_agent_repr_includes_name():
+    mock_model = MagicMock()
+    agent = SimpleAgent(tools=[], model=mock_model, name="test_agent")
+    # The __repr__ should contain the class name and the given agent name
+    r = repr(agent)
+    assert "SimpleAgent" in r
+    assert "name=test_agent" in r
